note: Original fictional campaigns. Each lists shipped operations in their in-game date order. An operation opens when the one before it has been won at the gate percentage or better in the commander's log. Nothing carries between operations: each is a different force in a different sea.

campaigns.name: NORTHERN FLANK, SEPTEMBER 1990
campaigns.summary: Five days in a fictional September 1990 crisis as it spreads north: a convoy across the North Sea, a submarine barrier south of Iceland and a carrier watch in the Norwegian Sea. It climbs from one star to three.

campaigns.name: FOUR CRISES, 2027
campaigns.summary: A fictional year in four seas: a missile-defence picket off the North Cape in March, the Taiwan Strait in April, a tanker transit through Hormuz in May and the Tartus line in October.
